verdict.rationale: API versioning and deprecation policy is a fair question for a game engine whose scripting and GDExtension APIs developers depend on, so the axis applies. The pack only shows release version numbers (Homebrew 4.7.2, a community remark that 3.5.2 is LTS) and a godot_version filter on the Asset Library API. None of these is a documented versioned-API scheme or a deprecation policy.
